title: Eden user-workflows document
description: Product-tier (P) registry document (doc 11 §6) cataloguing the end-to-end workflows a persona performs: each workflow names its triggering persona, the trigger condition, the ordered steps, and the resulting outcome. Canonical form: registry (YAML); the validator validates the {meta, data, sections} projection. Extends the common envelope.

type.description: Selects this schema; must be the literal string "user-workflows".

source.description: Conversation grounding is REQUIRED for product-tier (P) documents (doc 11 §4, tier P): at least one transcript span the workflows were elicited from.

items.description: The catalogue of user workflows. Author one entry per distinct end-to-end task a persona accomplishes with the system; at least one workflow is required.

id.description: Stable workflow identifier of the form WF-NNNN (e.g. WF-0002); unique within this document. This is the join key other documents cite via links (doc 11 §3).

name.description: Short imperative label naming the workflow from the user's standpoint (e.g. "Submit an expense report").

persona.description: The persona that performs this workflow, referenced as PER-NNNN; must resolve to a persona defined in product-charter (doc 11 §3, no dangling references).

trigger.description: EARS-style trigger: the condition or event that starts the workflow — WHEN <trigger> the persona begins this workflow (e.g. "WHEN a purchase exceeds the personal approval limit"). Markdown.

steps.description: The ordered sequence of actions the persona takes from trigger to outcome; at least one step is required. Each step is one user-facing action, written as markdown.

items.description: One step: a single user-facing action in imperative voice (e.g. "Attach the receipt image and confirm the total"). Markdown.

outcome.description: The observable end state once the workflow completes successfully — what the persona has achieved (e.g. "The report is queued for manager approval and the user sees a confirmation"). Markdown.

links.description: Typed upstream edges for this workflow (doc 11 §3, §7): e.g. realizes/refines the requirements (REQ-NNNN) or personas (PER-NNNN) this workflow serves. Upstream only; reverse edges are derived by tooling.
